messages:
Maya Patel: FYI — vendor ClearCloud emailed asking whether to submit a W-8 or a W-9. They also mention a 'gross-up' clause. Anyone on tax side who can confirm what we require?

Maya Patel: Vendor quote from email:
```
We are a US LLC but >50% owned by a UK parent. Which form should we provide? Also our contract has a clause that says Redwood will "gross-up" payments to cover any withholding tax — can you confirm if that's applicable?
```

Jules AP: tagging @Ben (Tax) — AP can't finalize vendor onboarding without classification. Do we treat them as US person for tax?

Ben (Tax): Quick check: if they are a US LLC taxed as a US entity, they should provide a W-9. If they're a foreign entity claiming treaty benefits, they'd provide W-8BEN-E + EORI/VAT where relevant. Ownership by a UK parent complicates things but primary factor is tax residency and how they're classified for US tax.

Samir Rao: Do we have the vendor's legal entity name and EIN on the invoice? That helps. If not, we should ask for a completed form.

Maya Patel: Invoice only has "ClearCloud Inc" and a US address, no EIN listed. They included a link to their accounting portal: https://billing.clearcloud.co/inv/7892 — looks like an LLC.

Ben (Tax): Ask them to complete W-9 first. If they push W-8 claiming foreign status, we need supporting docs. Regarding gross-up: we only agree to gross-up if contract explicitly states so and it's been approved by finance/legal. Default is no gross-up.

Jules AP: Noted. I'll reply asking for W-9 + copy of EIN. Also copied legal for any contract clause confirmation. @Samir can you flag this vendor so payments are on hold until we get the form?

Samir Rao: Done — placed payment hold in the portal and added AP note: "Awaiting W-9/EIN or valid W-8 supporting docs + legal approval for gross-up." :no_entry:

invoice-bot: Payment hold placed on invoice 7892 — status: ON_HOLD — reason: missing tax form.

ClearCloud: Thanks for the quick reply. We'll send the W-9 and EIN tomorrow morning. Regarding gross-up, our procurement rep said it's standard for cross-border contracts; if Redwood needs legal approval we'll await your guidance.

Ben (Tax): Thanks. Once we get the W-9 and EIN we can proceed with normal US vendor workflow — no withholding or gross-up expected. If they supply a W-8 later, we'll review and potentially apply withholding rates per IRS regs and tax treaties.

Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll update the vendor record once W-9 is received. Jules — follow up with legal on the gross-up clause, and we'll close this thread when the form is in hand. 

Jules AP: Yep, pinging legal now. Closing loop when W-9 in AP system. :white_check_mark:
